USE ZambiaZIGS
go
select ServiceID, name, s.Description, ap.ApplicationName as [Department/Agency]
from ZIGS_Services s
JOIN aspnet_Applications ap ON ap.ApplicationId = s.ApplicationId
        WHERE IsPublished = 1
        order by ServiceID

services.name: Agricultural Export Permit
services.description: The Agricultural Export Permit is a document that is given to a person to allow to sell agriculture products in foreign countries that are sourced or made in Zambia.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Agricultural Import Permit
services.description: The Agricultural Import Permit is a document that is issued to a person to allow to buy agriculture goods from foreign countries and bring them into Zambia.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Agricultural Transit Permit
services.description: The Agricultural Transit Permit is a document that is given to a person to allow to sell agriculture products in foreign countries that are sourced or made in Zambia.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Export Inspection
services.description: Service offered to individuals or companies involved in the export process to ensure that plant products and other regulated articles, being exported in Zambia are meeting the export conditions as per the provisions of the law.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Farm Inspection
services.description: Service offered to farm owners involved in plant growing, harvesting and storing to ensure based on the inspection, that growing and storing of plant products and other regulated articles are conducted as per the provisions of the law.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Fumigation Inspection
services.description: Service offered to registered fumigators involved in the disinfection process to ensure, based on the inspection, that fumigation is conducted as per the provisions of the law.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: General Inspection
services.description: Service offered to individuals or companies to ensure that growing media, plants, plant products, and other regulated materials are meeting phytosanitary standards as per provision of the law.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Import Inspection
services.description: Service offered to individuals or companies involved in the import process to ensure that plant products and other regulated articles, being imported in Zambia are meeting the import conditions as per the provisions of the law.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Issuance of Phytosanitary Certificate
services.description: Service offered to exporters involved in the export of plants, plant products, and other regulated articles to ensure that the exported plant products correspond to the phytosanitary measures as per the Internation Plant Protection Convention (IPPC).
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Issuance of Plant Import Permit
services.description: Service offered to individuals or organizations involved in the import of plants and plant products process to ensure that import is conducted as per the provisions of the law.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Issuance of Plant Movement Permit
services.description: Service offered to individuals or organizations involved in the movement of plants and plant products from one region to another within Zambia to ensure that movement is conducted as per the provisions of the law.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Laboratory Diagnostics
services.description: Service offered to importers and exporters involved in the plant growing, storing process, and trade to identify micro-organisms or their products, ensure that plant activities are conducted as per the provisions of the law.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Registration of Fumigators
services.description: Service offered to fumigators to ensure that they are certified by a recognized training institution or authority about fumigation and their fumigation activities are conducted as per the provisions of the law.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Registration of Plant Nurseries
services.description: Service offered to plant nursery owners involved in the plant growing process and trade to ensure that plant nursery activities are conducted as per the provisions of the law.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Registration of Premises (Tobacco)
services.description: This Service relates to the handling or storage of cured tobacco and issues the Tobacco Premises Licence based on the inspection of the premises. The inspection checks that it is suitable for handling and storing cured tobacco as well as free from pests.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Registration of Treatment Facilities
services.description: Service offered to wood packaging materials treatment facility companies involved in international trade to ensure based on the inspection, that plant treatment facility activities are conducted as per the provisions of the law.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Clearance of Imported Seed
services.description: This is a service that is offered to registered Seed Importers to ensure compliance with the Seed Law and Regulations with regards to seed clearance on imported seed. It is a requirement that any seed importer importing seed should be checked before the seed is distributed and sold.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Control Growing Tests
services.description: Service offered to registered seed growers involved in seed multiplication and market turnover processes to ensure that seed purity and variety identity are certified as per the provisions of the law.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Field Inspection
services.description: This is an official visual examination of a field that involves the inspection of actively growing plants before flowering, during flowering, and at full seed stage. This is a requirement by law (The Plant Variety and Seeds Act, SI No. 23 of 2018) to determine if seed can be certified. This service can also be initiated by a Seeds Inspector.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Issuance of Certifying Agency Licence
services.description: This is a service offered to Institutions who wish to be licensed as seed certifying agencies in compliance with the Seed Law and Regulations. The licence enables the institution to certify seeds as prescribed by the law.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Issuance of Seed Labels
services.description: Service offered to registered seed producing institutions involved in seed turnover processes to ensure that seed labels were issued based on the provisions of the law.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Registration of Seed Growers
services.description: Service which involves registration of a Seed Grower where important information is captured such as the name of the farm, location of the farm, crop to be grown, the variety to be grown and hectarage.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Seed Certificate
services.description: This is a service offered to the local and international seed industry. It involves evaluating the planting quality of seeds through provision of information on the physical and physiological attributes of the seed lots. This service is guided by and complies with the international seed testing rules as well as the Plant Variety and Seeds Act (CAP236) and its Regulations SI No. 23 of 2018.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Seed Import Permit
services.description: This is a service that is provided in order to facilitate the importation of seeds into the country.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Seed Importer’s Licence
services.description: This is a service that is provided to seed importers to import seeds into the country.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Seed Industry Personnel Licenses
services.description: This license is issued to Seed Industry Personnel in order to allow them participate in Seed Quality Control activities so as to enhance efficiency in seed quality delivery to the farming community. The licensing system was embarked on as a result of the robust growth and expansion of the Seed Industry because the current establishment and infrastructure could no longer fully support the growing demand of quality seed services.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Seed Processing Licence
services.description: Service offered to Seed Enterprises involved in seed processing to ensure that seed processing activities are conducted as per the provisions of the law.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Seed Sampling and Sealing
services.description: This is a service that is offered to any person who, having produced or acquired any prescribed seed which has not been tested or has been tested but expired and intends to sell the same for sowing shall, prior to offering the same for sale, cause a sample thereof to be taken in the manner prescribed, and shall cause the said sample to be delivered to a Certifying Agency together with a statement in writing specifying the origin, kind, variety, class and quantity of the said prescribed seed. The sampling of seed lots shall be conducted in accordance with Association rules in force at the time of the sampling. A seed lot which has been sampled in accordance with this Regulation may be moved from one place to another.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Seed Seller’s Licence
services.description: This is a service that is provided to seed traders to sell seeds at designated premises.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Seed Testing Licence
services.description: Service offered to enterprises offering seed testing services to ensure that seed testing activities are conducted as per the provisions of the law.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Training Seed Samplers, Inspectors and Analysts and Seed Growers
services.name_key: training seed samplers inspectors and analysts and seed growers
services.description: A service which involves provision of training to personnel and farmers. For seed growers, this training is a prerequisite for them to be registered as Seed Producers.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Variety Protection (Plant Breeder's Rights)
services.name_key: variety protection plant breeder s rights
services.description: This is a service that grants exclusive rights to the Plant Breeder of a new variety to enable him/her to exploit that variety. The objective of the PBR is to provide breeders with the opportunity to receive a reasonable return to their investments, thereby creating for them incentives to continue breeding and the recognition of their efforts. It is a form of intellectual property right (IPR) tailored to the protection of new plant varieties.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Variety Registration (Release)
services.description: Service offered to Variety Owners or their Representatives to commercialize a new variety that has been tested for its Value for Cultivation and Use (VCU).
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Variety Testing (Pre-Release)
services.description: Service offered to Variety Owners or their Representatives to assess the value for cultivation and use of a new variety.
services.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture

services.name: Application for an Exemption
services.description: This is an Application by an Enterprise that wishes to be exempted from a prohibition under Section twelve but does not apply to an Agreement that is prohibited per se. A prohibition is a conduct that is not allowed under the Act
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Application for Authorization - Mergers
services.description: Service offered to merging parties pursuant to Section 26 as read together with Section 24 of the Competition and Consumer Protection Act No. 24 of 2010 as amended by Act No. 21 of 2023. It is a mandatory requirement that all merging parties seek authorization for their proposed transactions if such transactions meet the required conditions as set out in the Act and SI No.97 of 2011.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Application for Authorization for Horizontal Agreements
services.name_key: application for authorization for horizontal agreements
services.description: A Horizontal Agreement is an agreement between enterprises each of which operates, for the purposes of the Agreement, at a different level of the production for the distribution chain and relates to the conditions under which the parties may purchase, sell or resell certain goods or services.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Application for Authorization for Vertical Agreements
services.name_key: application for authorization for vertical agreements
services.description: A Vertical Agreement is an agreement between enterprises each of which operates, for the purposes of the Agreement, at a different level of the production for the distribution chain and relates to the conditions under which the parties may purchase, sell or resell certain goods or services.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Application for Authorization of Investigation (Consumer Complaint)
services.name_key: application for authorization of investigation consumer complaint
services.description: This is an investigation by the Commission of Customer Complaint regarding an action alleged to be contrary to law, pursuant to the Competition and Consumer Protection Act No. 24 of 2010 as amended by Act No. 21 of 2023.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Application for Negative Clearance
services.description: This is an application by parties to a merger transaction seeking clarification as to whether the proposed merger requires the authorization of the Commission under Section 26 or is subject to review by the Commission under Section 27. It is a certification by the Commission that otherwise uncompetitive conduct can be allowed under conditions specified by the Commission.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Company Registration for Permit to Manufacture, Repair and Service Weighing and Measuring Instruments
services.name_key: company registration for permit to manufacture repair and service weighing and measuring instruments
services.description: Registration of Companies and Organisations that install, service and repair regulated measuring instruments.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Type Approval
services.description: This service involves the evaluation of a new model or type of measuring instrument to determine its suitability for reliable measurement results.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Verification of Electricity Meters
services.description: This service involves examination of measuring instrument(s) and marking or issuing a certificate that ascertains and confirms compliance with the Metrology Statutory requirements.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Verification of Length Measuring Instruments
services.description: This service involves examination of measuring instrument(s) and marking or issuing a certificate that ascertains and confirms compliance with the Metrology Statutory requirements.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Verification of Tanker Vehicle
services.description: This service involves examination of Verification of Tanker Vehicle(s) and marking or issuing a certificate that ascertains and confirms compliance with the Metrology Statutory requirements.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Verification of Volume Measuring Instruments
services.description: This service involves examination of volume measuring instrument(s) and marking or issuing a certificate that ascertains and confirms compliance with the Metrology Statutory requirements.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Verification of Weighing Instruments
services.description: This service involves examination of measuring instrument(s) and marking or issuing a certificate that ascertains and confirms compliance with the Metrology Statutory requirements.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Alteration in Capital
services.description: This is an application that may be used to alter capital in order to meet the minimum capital requirements or reduce the capital in reducing the liability of shareholder or increasing the nominal capital as way to meet the operating capital of the company
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Annual Return - Receipt of Statements of Accounts
services.name_key: annual return receipt of statements of accounts
services.description: This is an application to receive financial statements of a company.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Application for Conversion of a Company
services.name_key: application for conversion of a company
services.description: Conversion is a process of changing from one type of a company to another. A Private Company Limited by shares, Private Company Limited by Guarantee, an Unlimited Company or indeed a Public Limited Company may be converted into another type of a company if a special resolution is passed to that effect.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Application for Entity De-Registration
services.description: An entity may apply to the Registrar for voluntary de-registration due to liquidity reasons or end of joint venture etc.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Certificate of Existence (Printout)
services.description: Information kept by the Companies and the Business Names Registry is open to the public. Any member of the public can peruse any record upon payment of a search fee.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Certificate of Status
services.description: The process used to obtain detailed information of an Entity.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Change of Insolvency Details (Liquidator Address)
services.name_key: change of insolvency details liquidator address
services.description: Change of Insolvency Details (Liquidator Address)
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Change of Name
services.description: If a company changes its Name, it shall, within twenty-one days thereafter, lodge with the Registrar a notice of that fact, in the prescribed form and manner.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Compliance Status
services.description: This is a letter from the agency to remind a registered business to comply with a particular requirement e.g nominal share capital, annual return etc.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Name clearance
services.description: Name clearance is a process of checking for the existence of a proposed company or business name, done to ensure that the name proposed for the company or business, accepted for registration, does not exist or is not confusingly similar or misleading to the public.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Name reservation
services.description: Name Reservation is a process that is used to extend the reservation period for a cleared name. The reservation period is extended by 90 days from the date of payment of Name reservation.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: No-Change Annual Return
services.description: An Annual Return is a yearly statement that provides essential information about a company’s status. It gives a record of the nature of the company’s business, the location of its premises, its directors, secretary and members, among others. The law requires that Annual Returns be filed within three months of a company’s financial year end. Alternatively they can be filed within one month after the annual general meeting if such a meeting is held three months after the end of the financial year.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Notice of Alteration of Particulars
services.description: If a company changes its records office/address, it shall, within twenty-one days thereafter, lodge with the Registrar a notice of that fact, in the prescribed form and manner.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Notice of Appointment as Receiver, Liquidator or Business Rescue Administrator
services.name_key: notice of appointment as receiver liquidator or business rescue administrator
services.description: a. A person who obtains an order for the appointment of a receiver, or appoints a receiver is required to register a notice of appointment with the Registrar within 14 days. b. Members may by special resolution, resolve that the company voluntarily begins business rescue proceedings and place the company under supervision. c. After the commencement of the winding-up of the company, the company shall, by special resolution, appoint liquidator/s.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Notice of cessation of Receiver/Business Rescue Administrator or Liquidator
services.name_key: notice of cessation of receiver business rescue administrator or liquidator
services.description: This application is filed when a person appointed as Receiver ceases as such.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Notice of Change of Location of Receiver and Business Rescue Administrator
services.name_key: notice of change of location of receiver and business rescue administrator
services.description: Notice of Change of Location of Receiver and Business Rescue Administrator
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Notice of Statement of Company Affairs
services.name_key: notice of statement of company affairs
services.description: Statement of Affairs is a critically important document within the insolvency process that provides an overview of the company's assets and liabilities. Once completed, the Statement of Affairs has to be lodged with Registrar by the Insolvency Practitioner.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Notice to Dispose of Company Assets
services.name_key: notice to dispose of company assets
services.description: Notice to Dispose off Company Assets
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Registration of a New Business Entity
services.name_key: registration of a new business entity
services.description: This is an application to register a new Limited Company or Foreign Company.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Registration of Corporate Account Manager
services.description: Register User at PACRA
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Request for Annual Return Invoice
services.description: Request for Annual Return Invoice
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Integrated Laboratory Testing Services
services.description: The Integrated Laboratory Testing Service offers accredited physical, chemical, microbiological, chromatographic, and electrical analysis across a wide range of products - including food, water, petroleum, pharmaceuticals, construction materials, electrical items, textiles, and packaging and others. Open to individuals, academia, industries, SMEs, and regulators, this service ensures product safety, quality assurance, and compliance with national and international standards. Testing is performed in ISO/IEC SADCAS-accredited laboratories, providing credible and reliable results for both regulatory and commercial needs.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Management Systems Certification
services.description: The Management Systems Certification service is available to all types of organizations—including manufacturers, processors, service providers, extractive industries, utilities, regulators, public sector institutions, and NGOs. It verifies that an organization’s operations, procedures, internal processes, and strategic objectives comply with the requirements of relevant international management systems standards.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Product Certification - Certified Local Supplier Scheme
services.name_key: product certification certified local supplier scheme
services.description: The Certified Local Supplier Scheme (CLSS) is a product certification service tailored for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) involved in the manufacturing and processing of raw materials, semi-processed, and finished products. The scheme verifies and confirms that products meet applicable national standards and scheme-specific requirements, supporting product quality, safety, and market credibility.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Product Certification - Quality Mark
services.description: The Quality Mark is a service offered to the industry sector, specifically to manufacturers and processors of raw materials, semi-processed, and finished products. It serves to attest and confirm that products meet the relevant standards and technical specifications, ensuring consistency, safety, and reliability.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Sale of Standards
services.description: This service provides the public with access to information on standards and related publications. It is available to Individuals, Companies, and Institutions, including Quasi-Government organizations.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Training Services
services.description: The Training Services provides structured capacity-building programs in Management Systems Standards to individuals, companies, and institutions. Available as open sessions or in-house training (with a minimum of 5 participants), the service supports skill development and compliance with standards such as ISO. Applications are open for new enrollments only.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Application for Annual Import Quality Certificate
services.name_key: application for annual import quality certificate
services.description: A document issued annually by the agency to an importer of a commodity of the same brand from the same manufacturer and the same country of origin after four consecutive import shipments have been evaluated and found to conform to the relevant standards determined under the act.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Application for Pre-Import Clearance
services.description: A document issued every six months by the agency to an importer of a commodity of the same brand from the same manufacturer and the same country of origin.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Clearance of Used Motor Vehicles
services.description: This is a Clearance of Imports of used motor vehicles meant for use on Zambian roads.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Foreign Road Tank Vehicle Inspection
services.description: This is a License issued to Foreign Transporters of petroleum-based flammable liquids traversing Zambian roads.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Issuance of Batch Certificate
services.description: This is a license that permits an Importer or Supplier to supply a product subject to a compulsory standard, on the Zambian Market. A compulsory standard is a standard with which compliance is mandatory by law.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Local Road Tank Vehicle Inspections
services.description: This is a License issued to Local Transporters of petroleum-based flammable liquids traversing Zambian roads.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Permit to Supply
services.description: This is a license that permits a local Manufacturer or Supplier to supply a product subject to a compulsory standard. A compulsory standard is a standard with which compliance is mandatory by law.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Timber Inspections
services.description: This is a service provided to Exporters of Timber to confirm that the timber intended to be exported meets the minimum export requirements. It is a delegated function from the Forestry Department.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Activation of Incentives
services.description: ZDA offers fiscal and non-fiscal incentives to attract foreign/local investors into priority sectors. The investor/company should invest in any of the priority sectors: Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, ICT, and Water Supply. The investor/company should be located in either a Rural Area, Special Economic Zone or Farm Block. For construction and hydro, the investor/company can be located anywhere else. Except under the energy sector, the construction of filling stations should be located in a rural area. For projects operating in the manufacturing sector and energy sector (construction of rural filling stations) applicants must demonstrate that they are either in a rural area, or SEZ/Industrial Park.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Amendment of Certificate of Registration (Investor)
services.name_key: amendment of certificate of registration investor
services.description: This service involves the amendment of investment details. The ICoR/MFEZ Permit is amendable in the following details: 1. Project description/Sub sector. 2. Project location. 3. Company name. 4. Committed investment amount. 5. Conversion of the ICoR to an MFEZ Permit or vice versa. NB: The Sector is not amendable. ZDA issues sector-specific ICoR/MFEZ permits, and in case of misclassification (demonstrated or justified), then the sector can be amended. Where misclassification is not demonstrated or justified, the client must make an application.
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Amendment of SEZ Operator Permit
services.description: This service involves the amendment of investment details. The SEZ Operator Permit is amendable in the following details: Project description/Sub sector, Project location, Company name, Committed investment amount. The Sector is not amendable. Applicant can also request the conversion of the SEZ Operator Permit to an Investor Certificate. Applications may be submitted while the Permit is still valid. Original paper Permit (shall be submitted to the selected office after application).
services.ministry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

services.name: Certificate of Registration (Enterprise)
services.description: A Certificate of Registration (Enterprise) is a digital certificate recording the information of an enterprise about an investment project. It is issued to Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises to give them access to Zambia Development Agency incentives and services to support and grow their business.

services.ministry: Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources

services.name: Land Survey

services.description: Printing services for Maps and Other Products

services.name: Provide Mapping Services (Existing Geo-Information/Map/Image Products)
services.name_key: provide mapping services existing geo information map image products

services.ministry: Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources

services.name: Provide New Mapping Services (Geo-Information/Map/Image Products)
services.name_key: provide new mapping services geo information map image products

services.ministry: Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources

services.name: Annual Market Occupancy Permit
services.description: A Permit issued for the allocation of trading space within a Council run Market.
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.description: Every couple intending to marry as a statutory marriage shall register with the local District Registrar to be issued with a marriage certificate as official proof of their union. This service allows couples to submit a statutory marriage notice, pay the applicable fee, and complete the legal steps required for marriage under the Marriage Act. It also supports cancellation before the marriage is solemnised.
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Building Permit
services.description: This permit is issued by a planning authority to individuals and organizations seeking to undertake construction or make significant changes to buildings (and affected land), ensuring the project aligns with approved spatial plans, zoning laws, safety standards, and promotes orderly urban development according to the Urban and Regional Planning Act of 2015.
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Burial Permit
services.description: A burial permit issued by the local council in accordance with the Births and Deaths Registration Act and the Public Health Act, authorising the burial of a deceased person within the council jurisdiction.
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Bus Station Loading (Gate Pass) Fee
services.name_key: bus station loading gate pass fee
services.description: This fee is charged to bus operators for loading passengers at the station and designated loading bays. It applies to local, intercity, and international departures. International buses from other countries passing through Zambia must pass through the Intercity Bus Terminus before proceeding. The service is available until 16:00 hrs. Bus Station Occupancy Permit and RTSA Registration to be presented along with the Loading Fee Receipt to proceed to the loading bay.
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Bus Station Storage Fees
services.description: A fee collected from persons who wish to keep their goods in the Council Bus Station managed storeroom or facilities for a specific period.
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Business Levy
services.description: Every business enterprise operating within the jurisdiction of a local authority shall, in accordance with the Local Government Act and the Local Government (Business Levy) Regulations, pay a business levy as prescribed.
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Fire Certificate
services.description: This is a Certificate that is issued to individuals, institutions, and organisations for the purpose of certifying a designated premises as being safe from fire or related hazards.
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Firearm Licence
services.description: A Firearm License is a service provided by Local Authorities, acting as licensing authorities under the Firearms Act, Chapter 110 of the Laws of Zambia, which authorizes eligible individuals or organizations to lawfully purchase, acquire, possess, and use firearms and ammunition, subject to compliance with statutory requirements and license conditions
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Food Handlers Certificate
services.description: In accordance with the Public Health Act Cap 295 of the Laws of Zambia, The Food and Drugs Act Cap 303 and the food safety Regulations (Statutory Instrument 36 of 2001), any person engaging in the handling, preparation, storage, transportation or sale of food must be certified medically fit to safely handle food without posing a risk to Public Health.
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Grave Allocation
services.description: This service provides for the allocation of a grave space within a designated cemetery for the burial of a deceased person.
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Health Permit
services.description: This is a permit that ensures that businesses are in compliance with the minimum requirements of public health regulations.
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Hire of Halls
services.description: Hire of Council’s facilities, including halls and designated photo-booth spaces, by members of the public for various activities such as meetings, weddings, conferences, exhibitions, and other events.
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Lease of Council Properties
services.description: A service that allows individuals and organizations to pay for the rental or lease of properties owned or managed by the Council
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Liquor Licence
services.description: A Liquor Licence is a permit issued by Local Authorities under the Liquor Licensing Act No. 20 of 2011 that authorizes businesses such as wholesalers, retailers, nightclubs, restaurants, bars, and other hospitality establishments to legally sell and distribute alcoholic beverages, subject to compliance with regulatory requirements and operating conditions, while an Extension of Hours is a sub-service offered by Local Councils allowing licensed premises such as nightclubs, bars, and restaurants to operate beyond standard permitted hours as approved by council resolution, granted upon application and charged based on the number of additional hours approved.
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Market Ablution Fees

services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Market Storage Fees
services.description: A fee collected from traders (stand/stall/shop owners) who wish to keep their goods in the Council Market managed storeroom or facilities for a specific period.
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Meat Inspection
services.description: Meat Inspection is conducted in a slaughter facility for the purpose of controlling animal diseases and residues in meat. All food meat carcasses must be inspected by an authorized officer (Health Inspector) to certify it fit for human consumption.
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Outdoor Advertisement
services.description: Authorisation for the outdoor advertisement of products and services within the jurisdiction of the local authority: 1) Permit to install or display Outdoor Advertisement; 2) Monthly Fee – periodic payment for each Outdoor Advertisement; 3) Permit Renewal Fee – renewal fee for Outdoor Advertisement; 4) Amendment – change of advertisement location or size. 5) Registration as a new Agent – authorisation for rental of Outdoor Advertisement (optional service available only for Business Entities and Co-operatives); 6) Termination (by Applicant) – removal of Outdoor Advertisement before the expiration of Permit.
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Parking Disc Permit
services.description: This e-service allows eligible individuals or organizations to apply online for a Parking Disc Permit authorizing a specified vehicle or fleet of vehicles to access and use general Council-managed parking slots within designated parking areas in Lusaka, including the CBD/Town Centre and Kamwala.
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Personal Levy

services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Petroleum Storage Licence
services.description: This is a Licence issued to individuals and/or organizations to possess dangerous petroleum goods (diesel, petrol, kerosine, Liquefied Petroleum Gas, Ammonium Nitrate, etc) for commercial and non-commercial purposes
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Pole Levy
services.description: A levy imposed by the Council and paid by Organization(s) for the privilege of erecting or maintaining poles for electricity, telecommunications or other services within the district.
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Property Rates
services.description: Property rates are annual levies imposed by the local council on all rateable properties within its jurisdiction in accordance with the Rating Act No. 21 of 2018. The Council bills property once a year and each bill must be paid within that year. If a property has arrears, those must be settled first, or the full outstanding balance may be paid in a single payment.
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Reserved Parking Permit (CBD)

services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Site Rent
services.description: A quarterly amount payable by a property owner (houses, shops) in each unplanned settlement area within a local authority
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Subdivision of Land
services.description: Service authorizes property owners or their authorized representatives to lawfully subdivide land into two or more plots, subject to compliance with approved zoning regulations, planning standards, infrastructure requirements, and any conditions imposed by the Planning Authority. Outstanding Property Rates arrears must be paid before applying for this service.
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Telecommunication Mast Levy
services.description: An annual levy payable to the Council, per mast, by an individual or organisation that constructs or maintains a telecommunication mast within the jurisdiction of the local authority.
services.ministry: Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development

services.name: Alteration of Exploration or Mining Area

services.description: A holder intending to alter the exploration area or mining area shall apply to the Director of Mining Cadastre in the prescribed manner and form upon payment of the prescribed fee. services.ministry: Ministry of Mines and Minerals Development

services.name: Amendment of a Mining Right or Mineral Processing Licence
services.name_key: amendment of a mining right or mineral processing licence

services.ministry: Ministry of Mines and Minerals Development

services.description: A holder of a mining right may apply for the renewal of the mining or non-mining right in the prescribed manner and form upon payment of the prescribed fee. services.ministry: Ministry of Mines and Minerals Development

services.ministry: Ministry of Mines and Minerals Development

services.name: Mineral Processing Licence Renewal
services.description: A holder of a non-mining right may apply for the renewal of the mining or non-mining right in the prescribed manner and form upon payment of the prescribed fee. services.ministry: Ministry of Mines and Minerals Development

services.name: Mining and Non-Mining Rights Area Charges

services.ministry: Ministry of Mines and Minerals Development

services.name: Mining and Non-Mining Rights Licence Transfer
services.name_key: mining and non mining rights licence transfer
services.description: A holder of a mining right or mineral processing licence or a person with an interest in a mining right or mineral processing licence who intends to transfer, assign, encumber or otherwise deal with the mining right or mineral processing licence or any interest therein shall apply to the Minister for approval in the prescribed manner and form upon payment of the prescribed fee. services.ministry: Ministry of Mines and Minerals Development

services.name: Mining and Non-Mining Rights Reports
services.name_key: mining and non mining rights reports

services.ministry: Ministry of Mines and Minerals Development

services.name: Permit to Purchase, Acquire and Possess Explosives

services.description: The service allows Mining Companies and Mining-Related Entities to submit responses regarding the appointment of personnel to prescribed management positions.
